page_title: STR 1-3 MON | Strasbourg v Monaco 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.

90+9' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Djordje Petrovic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+7' The ball is cleared after Lamine Camara (Monaco) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
90+6' That will be all from Soungoutou Magassa who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jordan Teze (Monaco).
90+4' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Habib Diarra will be replaced by Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg).
90+4' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Takumi Minamino as he is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
90+3' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
90+2' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Strasbourg get a corner.
90+1' 1 - 3 GOAL! George Ilenikhena (Monaco) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:3.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' The substitution is prepared. Milos Lukovic (Strasbourg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ismael Doukoure.

89' 1 - 2 Goal! Maghnes Akliouche shows great vision to find Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
87' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it goes just over the crossbar.
87' The attendance is 67100.
86' Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sebastian Nanasi departs the field of play to be replaced by Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg).
82' The referee shows the yellow card to Habib Diarra (Strasbourg).

82' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball after the free kick and takes good first touch to unleash a low shot from close range, but Djordje Petrovic makes a nice save.
81' It looks like Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) saw red with that tackle. Benjamin Lepaysant won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Monaco.
79' 1 - 1 Goal! Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Djordje Petrovic.
79' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is going to take the penalty!
78' Benjamin Lepaysant rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Diego Moreira (Strasbourg).
78' It’s a PENALTY to Monaco after the VAR review!
76' There's a break in play and referee Benjamin Lepaysant must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Monaco using VAR. This could be interesting!
75' That looked a certain handball by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
75' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) blows a good chance to score. He collects a pass inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the goal is brilliantly blocked. Great defending!
73' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) has a huge chance to score from close range, but his effort goes just a few inches wide of the right-hand post.
70' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
66' Vanderson (Monaco) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
63' Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
63' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) commits a foul and Benjamin Lepaysant immediately signals a free kick.
61' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Lamine Camara (Monaco), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!

59' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Monaco are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
58' Vanderson (Monaco) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic is equal to it and makes an easy save.
57' It looks like the ref can’t continue. He’s going to be replaced by Benjamin Lepaysant.
53' A pass from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is intercepted by Radoslaw Majecki and the move breaks down.
50' Monaco are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) replacing Caio Henrique.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and George Ilenikhena (Monaco) comes onto the pitch so that Breel Embolo can be given a rest.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
41' Vanderson (Monaco) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.

39' A pass travels right across the box to Breel Embolo (Monaco) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic denies him with a decent save.
35' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
35' A lofted pass into the box is met by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post.
32' Lamine Camara (Monaco) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
29' 1 - 0 Guela Doue (Strasbourg) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom right corner. What a brilliant finish!
27' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
25' Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
25' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
24' Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
24' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. Bastien Dechepy had a clear view and blows his whistle.
22' Caio Henrique (Monaco) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

18' Breel Embolo (Monaco) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Djordje Petrovic to get hold of the ball.
15' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Radoslaw Majecki stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
13' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Guela Doue (Strasbourg), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
11' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

8' Lamine Camara (Monaco) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
7' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) is penalised for holding. Bastien Dechepy signals a set piece. Monaco have a free kick from a promising distance.
6' A precise cross towards the penalty spot was latched onto by Breel Embolo (Monaco). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the left post.
5' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
4' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
4' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Bastien Dechepy signals. Strasbourg win a free kick.
2' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) handles the ball inside the box.
2' Lamine Camara (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

1' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Strasbourg will kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
